summary: A per-token-count Triton config table tuned for the A100-SXM4-80GB plus mask-elision fast paths in fused_moe_kernel cut the fused MoE geomean from 680.657 us to 633.49 us (1.074x, 7.4% faster), with every token count improving and all outputs still within 2e-2 of the fp32 reference. Six buildable candidates were measured over three rounds; kern1 was the only one to clear the 1% bar over the best so far. The serving check could not run: both the seed and kern1 images fail identically at `vllm bench serve` startup with ModuleNotFoundError: No module named 'vllm.benchmarks.lib' (the vLLM repo's own .dockerignore excludes vllm/benchmarks/lib/ from the image), so no serving numbers were produced for either side.
